correctness.rationale: The Cartier coefficients are reconstructed using the p-semi-linear Cartier monomial rule on the three holomorphic differentials. A coefficient-polynomial ODE, Lucas congruences forcing multiplicity m+1 at both discriminant roots, and uniqueness of degree-m ODE solutions prove the exact bivariate coefficient identity for every p=6m+5. The smooth discriminant is nonzero, making the paired Cartier block simultaneously invertible or zero. ODE uniqueness also proves H_m has m simple roots away from ±2; parity plus the established marked scaling law gives ceil(m/2) marked classes. A standalone stdlib exact symbolic checker passed the identity, squarefreeness and coefficient tests in 23 inert primes through 197, but these finite tests are corroboration, not the infinite proof. Boundary p=5 gives H_0=1 and no superspecial fiber.

originality.rationale: The full family, its Prym and marked symmetries, and the isolated Fermat superspecial case are pre-existing. The new claim is the uniform all-inert-prime discriminant factorization of the second Cartier coefficient, an explicit exact reduced superspecial locus with m simple roots, and its complete marked-class count. Primary full texts and targeted published-record comparisons, including an earlier split-prime coefficient result, did not yield a mathematically dominating statement. Priority risk from differently parametrized or unindexed work remains; no claim of independently certified novelty.
residual_risks: An older or unindexed equivalent special-function / Cartier computation under different coordinates cannot be excluded by searches alone.
The 2023 general Cartier source states a uniform a-number result at p≡2 mod3 conflicting with Fermat exceptions; the new proof does not rely on that unsupported claim.
Unmarked geometric isomorphisms can identify more classes than marked μ6-isomorphisms, so the class count is expressly marked only.

value.rationale: The superspecial locus is a natural global Hasse divisor of a genus-three Prym family with extra automorphisms, not an arbitrary isolated numerical parameter. Its reduced structure, exact degree, all-prime Cartier-rank dichotomy and marked-isomorphism class count are natural geometric/arithmetic invariants. This refines the known fixed Fermat example and distinguishes whole-locus arithmetic not supplied by geometric construction. No claim of full Newton polygon, finite-field rational-frequency counts or unmarked class census is made.
